rules: Write only the stagingPath; never write canonical Lesson files from a worker.
Treat the packet spec as provisional. The Integration Writer rechecks the live canonical spec in order.
Keep learner role and story participants variable; do not mechanically repeat the immediately previous cast.
Do not invent lexical/reference evidence. Use only candidates/evidence allowed by the packet.
Expose every dialogue, audio, or visual context before any activity that depends on it; never test unseen context.
Never claim or rely on an image/photo/visual unless the activity has an actual renderable runtime asset/config.
Every listening instruction must have a playable audio source on that learner step.
Do not generate paid audio during worker authoring.
